messages.opening: What if your AI agents could spend — but never beyond your authority?
messages.closing: Authorize once. Operate within limits. Verify every transaction. Eterna.AI — Own Your Agent.

narration.opening: This is Eterna: the control layer for agents that spend real money.
narration.problem: Rose is a CFO. Her teams’ AI agents buy data and software every day. Today she either approves every purchase herself, or trusts permissions she can’t check.
narration.solution: With Eterna, Rose signs once, from her own wallet: up to one XRP in total, approved merchants only, until the end of demo day. Eterna holds the rules. It never holds her keys.
narration.transaction: Her agent asks to buy a validated XRPL ledger report for zero point one XRP. Eterna checks identity, merchant, amount, expiry and remaining budget — and pays, without asking Rose again.
narration.proof: This is XRPL Mainnet. Here is the transaction hash. Two independent ledger readers confirmed settlement before anything was delivered.
narration.outcome: Only then does the report unlock. Rose can view it, download it, and prove it is exactly what was paid for.
narration.closing: Her agents can spend. They can’t exceed her authority.
